entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Colonel Ruby Bradley was a United States Army Nurse Corps officer, a prisoner of the Japanese in World War II, and one of the most decorated women in the United States military. She was a native of Spencer, West Virginia, but lived in Falls Church, Virginia, for over 50 years.
